content.text:
Audit complete; no files changed.

| Capability | Web | Mobile |
|---|---|---|
| Chat catalog | Broad Pi catalog: 35 providers / 999 built-in models in the installed package, plus Not Organic, MiniMax compatibility entries, saved models, and discoverable custom endpoints | Searchable, cached `models.dev` catalog, but deliberately restricted to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and OpenRouter |
| Voice/realtime selection | Separate persisted provider/model/voice selection; TTS and duplex realtime are distinct | No native live/realtime model selection; opens web Live |
| Image generation selection | Separate persisted generator/model selection; static OpenAI list or free-form local endpoint | No generation provider/model path |
| Video generation selection | None; “video” is camera/screen input for live voice, not a generation model | None |

The current live `models.dev` response has 183 providers and 6,248 raw models. Mobile admits only four providers containing 438 raw models before its chat/transport filtering (about 7% of the catalog). That is intentional: its native request code only knows the four provider protocols plus a generic custom OpenAI-compatible route.

Key evidence:

- Mobile’s `ProviderId` is closed to `openai | anthropic | google | openrouter | custom`, and `CatalogModel.transport` must match a fixed native transport map: [model-catalog.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:13), [model-catalog.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:24), [model-catalog.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:52).
- The models.dev parser explicitly whitelists those four providers, requires text output plus context, and filters known incompatible modality/model IDs: [model-catalog.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:55), [model-catalog.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:140).
- Mobile persists the fetched catalog and recents in AsyncStorage, refreshes with a 30-second timeout, and preserves cached/built-in models on failure: [model-catalog-storage.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog-storage.ts:9), [model-catalog-storage.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog-storage.ts:36), [ModelSelectorSheet.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:66).
- Mobile’s selector supports search plus multi-provider and AND-capability filters, then atomically changes provider, model, and base URL through one `ProviderSettings` object: [ModelSelectorSheet.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/components/ModelSelectorSheet.tsx:139), [model-catalog.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/model-catalog.ts:262), [KeatingProvider.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/state/KeatingProvider.tsx:885).
- Its runtime request builder contains separate OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, Gemini, and OpenAI-compatible/OpenRouter paths—so admitting arbitrary models.dev providers would create success-looking but non-callable choices: [provider-client.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/lib/provider-client.ts:169).

Web does not consume models.dev. Its chat picker sources Pi’s `getProviders()` / `getModels()`, local WebGPU models, saved models, and custom discovery:

- Picker discovery and search/filter UI: [ModelSelector.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx:94), [ModelSelector.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx:169), [ModelSelector.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx:277).
- Source union: Pi catalog, Not Organic, MiniMax, and custom providers: [provider-models.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/provider-models.ts:389).
- Custom discovery supports Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, and OpenAI-compatible gateways via the same-origin proxy: [provider-models.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/provider-models.ts:12), [provider-models.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/provider-models.ts:119), [provider-models.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/provider-models.ts:248).
- Switching a web chat model is blocked mid-stream and otherwise recreates the agent with the selected `Model<Api>`: [useKeatingAgent.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/hooks/useKeatingAgent.tsx:2115).

Web modality separation is materially better than mobile, but it is static/curated rather than catalog-driven:

- Image state is separate `imageGenerator`/`imageModel`; allowed OpenAI models and local free-form mode live in [image-generators.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/lib/image-generators.ts:5), and the picker only receives that generator’s list: [ModelSelector.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx:759).
- Voice state is independently persisted in `WebSpeechSettings`, including provider, model, voice, mic/video flags, and reasoning effort: [speech.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/speech.ts:38).
- TTS and duplex realtime are distinct kinds; the model dialog only shows the selected speech provider’s compatible models: [speech.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/speech.ts:331), [ModelSelector.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx:805).
- Live model choice has a second curated catalog, distinct from the speech-provider model lists: [live-models.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/live-models.ts:36), [openai-realtime.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/speech-providers/openai-realtime.ts:154). For example, Speech Settings exposes `gpt-realtime-2`, while `/live` does not. This is a small internal drift risk.
- Web “video” means live camera/screen capability. Gemini gets native realtime video; OpenAI gets sampled still frames: [capabilities.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/providers/capabilities.ts:112), [capabilities.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/providers/capabilities.ts:342). There is no `generate_video` tool, endpoint, settings contract, or video-generation model picker.
- Mobile explicitly declares native Live unavailable and hands off to web: [live.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/mobile/src/app/(tabs)/live.tsx:30).

Smallest safe implementation slice:

1. Do not expose all 183 models.dev providers as selectable. A catalog entry does not supply a supported transport, endpoint convention, credential/OAuth flow, or streaming parser.
2. Unify web’s two duplex model registries first: make `live-models.ts` the capability/grade source and derive the OpenAI/Gemini speech-provider lists from it. This is low-risk, removes the `gpt-realtime-2` inconsistency, and keeps selection modality-specific.
3. If shared catalog behavior is desired next, add models.dev only as a metadata overlay for providers already callable on each surface—four mobile-native providers and matching web Pi providers. Merge metadata by `provider + model id`; preserve Pi/custom models as selectable sources; never enable a models.dev-only provider.
4. Treat actual mobile live voice, image generation, and video generation as separate product slices. Each needs its own persisted selection contract and native transport/tool implementation; reusing mobile `ProviderSettings` would incorrectly bind those choices to chat.

No runtime/browser acceptance was performed; this is source and local dependency/catalog evidence.
